name: GnosisChain
notes: Default: the official owl mark from gnosischain/media-kit (Logos/Owl_Logo - Mark.svg, #0D0D0D), without the file's no-op clip group; the kit's Gnosis Chain lockups are wordmark-only, so this is the only official mark. It replaces a #3E6957 owl whose colour is not in the kit (palette: Moss #133629, Cream #F0EBDE)
Mono: the same four owl paths in currentColor
